book.name: Malaka
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Malaka byex o

content: Qayeeng pakeing wei xukana wei wain o

Woyom Yesu luk wou xel teivateiv eivek qayeeng pakeing. “Tambiy ti ev xuk wain. E qo tete vivekwou, me ev leiveeng wei qeing wain o, me ev xomek vaxading wei yeingteyei xuk wain o. Woyom moxo toung xuk wain eivek xel valu memend bei xel bo xuk vateivek lek me dembu wain neing wou ma, veweeng wou xuk ma de veweeng wou xel venaxow dom la beyeeng dingta.
Lek bouk wei uleing wain neing eno moxo wong xukxe ti la wou xel wei mi yeiteyei xuk bei na qou wain neing valu eivek xuk wain.
Ekom xel zeimaxoun e, me leis e wo nol dom wong moxo lox me la mema nivax.
Woyom moxo wong xukxe nge la wou xel, me xel sesa moux tine lek e lu de xel se ngo e vya qe xel wo niyalenyeing ngandoung wou e.
E wong xukxe nge lox no, om tiyon mou xel leis e mey. E wong xel ngenongakes la, ekom xel sesa valu, de xel leis xel valu mey.
“E xe tixemou tateis toundei en ingwei embei bong ena yo, neu moux tiwei e lalei vind o. E wong ela ti yusayang, me neil, ‘Tyek xel gwevek a neung xe qayeeng.’
“Ekom xel xukxe wei wain o neil wouma, ‘Tambiy tine tyek na qou ma xe lulul dalus. Xam lam en xey a nyeis e mey o, dom lulul dalus on tyek inyon xe xe.’
Om xel zeimaxoun e me leis e mey, dom nex e la myayaing veil xuk wain.
“Woyom Yesu teling xel “tyek xuk wain ma bo vati? Tyek moxo nam dom nyeis xel xukxe dom bong xuk wain na wou xel bange.
Beip xam seng mi pyaw xoulek tine?

content.text: “‘Qakous mundeeng ti wei xel kamunda pesek,
eno wong ambei qakous ti myaxeeng wei nale me mi byexaxoun xomek o.
Tambiy Ngandoung wong tine, me xa xei lek mami me inye wo etekeing wou xa.’” Qapiya Lalo 118:22-23

content: Woyom xel leitata yimexe sakwaing ti en xel embei zeimaxoun e en nambei xel woulek bei e neil qayeeng pakeing lek xel. Ekom xel yaleeng en xel qendu ngandoung on, om xel ghanaw e me la.
Toungeing takis wou Sisa
Kalekom xel wong Parisi valu me xel wei Herot o valu la wou Yesu bei tandei e en emaxow xe qayeeng wei embei neil ena sewok o.

Xel lam wou e me neil, “Putoung, xa woulek bei wang on tambiy neing. Wa seng mi waleeng en xelti, me wa seng mi wei bei inyon xel eti yeiw, qe wang mi teyoxe sakwaing wei Anutu yo me ghe betiwou qayeeng zonghek. Om petieing neil embei xey a toung takis wou Sisa o xe se toung?
Xey a toung o xe se toung?” Ekom Yesu woulek bei xel on myend yuw om neil wou xel bei, “Nambei nya xam ghe di tandei ay? Qou selewa ti lam wou ay, me a xei.”
Xel qou selewa ti me lam, om moxo teling xel, “Eti xe tenu ing tine? Me eti lei inye?” Xel neil elox, “Sisa.”
Woyom Yesu neil wou xel, “Xam ghe bong vati wei Sisa xe yo wou Sisa, dom ghe bong vati wei Anutu xe yo wou Anutu.” Om xel on etek en e.
Iingama lek bouk wei qandieing lek o
Woyom xel Sadyusi, wei mi neil embei xel meyeing tyek se qandi lek eno lam wou e is telinyeing ti.
Xel neil, “Putoung, Mose byex qayeeng wou xey bei wangwei moux ti li na mey de venei nanghei toundei ekom neu ma, yond moux tiyon dii vexeiv on me bo li neuyeiw.
Woyom xel lim yuw lindama eno toundei. Tiwei tax eno ii vex on me mey ekom se wo neu ti.
Li nge wei yuw eno ii vexeiv on dom mey is, ekom se wo neu ti. Kwa kayon eno li tiwei yal o betiwou.
Om nambei nyon eno xel lim yuw on ti se wong neuyeiw ti, dekakom vex on mey loxyus en xel dalus.
Lek bouk wei qandieing lek, eno tyek vex on eti venei? En inyon xel lim yuw ii vex tiyon.”
Yesu neil elox, “Xam ghe neil qayeeng on la sewok en xam seng woulek xoulek wei dei yeip eivek qapiya me nikanzek wei Anutu yo.
Gyeik bouk wei xel meyeing qandi lek, eno xel se teyeimbei diima me diima nox me noum, tyek xel ghok ambei xel angela wei tyoung gheyapu yo.

De qayeeng wei meyeing e qandi lek, beip inye xam seng pyaw eivek qapiya wei Mose me eivek pavulek wei nenyex tum lek xax nayaka yo, de eivek pavulek wei Anutu neil wou e yo, ‘A ne Anutu wei Apraham, Anutu wei Isaka me Anutu wei Yakop o?’
Moxo se Anutu wei xel meyeing, qe e Anutu wei xel wei mapieing. Om qayeeng wei xam ghe neil on eno la sewok.”
Qayeeng Petieing tiwei ngandoungateiv o

Putoung wei petieing o ti lam me ngo xel di pyaw lekama lox me loum is Yesu. Me ngo bei Yesu lewexe lek qayeeng on wo nimza, om teling e, “Qayeeng petieing tina, inye ngandoung ghanaw veil en qayeeng petieing dalus?”
Yesu lewexe, “Tiwei ngandoung ghanaw veil eno inye: ‘Xam Israel ngo, Tambiy Ngandoung xe xe Anutu, emaxow tixemou yon Tambiy Ngandoung.
Xam laleimim devind Tambiy Ngandoung xam xe Anutu is laleimim dalus me is numim pieing dalus me is xam lumimpeyei dalus me is xam nimim kanzek dalus.’
Nge wei yuw eno inye: ‘Wa laleim e mi devind nimpapu nambei wa laleim mi vind xow o.’ Qayeeng petieing ti se ngandoung ghanaw yuw ne.”
Moux on neil elox, “Putoung, wang neil neing bei Anutu yon tixemou me xel ba ma dom emaxow.

Laleim vind e is laleim dalus me is wa lumpeyei dalus me is wa nimkanzek dalus me wa laleim devind nimpapu nambei wa laleim mi vind venaxow o. Inyon ngandoungateiv ghanaw xound wei seing dalus o me da leimalei.”
Gyeik Yesu yei bei e neil qayeeng nambei xel wei lupeyei nimza, om neil wou e, “Wa seng dei dingta veil tete lalei wei Anutu yo.” De woyom xel yaleeng om xelti se lox teling e no.
Kilisi yon eti neu
Ka Yesu di teyoxe xel eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing o, e teling, “Nambei nya ekom xel putoung wei petieing o neil embei Kilisi yon Dawit neu?
Dawit venaxow neil angya Laweeng Vambuing, me neilteyei bei:

content.text: “‘Tambiy Ngandoung neil wou a xe Tambiy Ngandoung:
deka a toung wa xe xel vevek amba na
xeinghembi eivek wa vaxam bole.”’ Qapiya Lalo 110:1

content: Dawit venaxow taxe Kilisi ne Tambiy Ngandoung. Nambei nya Kilisi yon Dawit neu is ambei nyon?” Xel qendu ngandoung on liw nenyend wou e is xeindlala.

Ka Yesu teyoxe xel, eno neil, “Xam ghe gwei xow teyei en xel putoung wei petieing o. Xel embei mi ghavineeng is teimb ding me xel embei xel a mi neil bendiyeing teiv wou xel eivek beyeeng wei vateivek o,
me xel embei mi mendei lek sia nimza wei xel wei leitata mi deilek o eivek xomek qekueing ama me mindei lek sia nimza wei tax wei xel lei laeing o eivek mata ngandoung.
Xel mi tyoxe xel vexeiv me qou xel xe xomek me talex xow en zeimeing mema ding. Xel moux ambei nyon eno tyek na qou myaveweeng ngandoung ghanaw xel bamba.”
Vexeiv ti xe da

Yesu dei paviy ingwei xel mi toung da nanghei yo, me di yei bembeeng vex alis moux di toung xel xe da la eivek qoupek malew wei xomek vambuing o. Xomaxoneing ngenong wei lulul ana eno toung malew ngandoung.
Ekom vexeiv kanyo ti eno lam me toung selewa nayak yayuw, nikanzek wei selewa ne eno teyei lek selewa gyand ti.
Yesu taxe e xe xel betiyeing lam wou e, me neil, “A neil wou xam zonghek, vexeiv kawei kanyo ne eno toung malew ngandoung eivek qoupek malew wei xomek vambuing o ghanaw xel bamba dalus.
En xel dalus wong xel xe lulul dalus eivek lulul ngenong wei xel o. Ekom vex on lulul ma dom wong e xe kayo dalus, de wong ingwei embei toumendei mapieing en eno dalus.”
